info.title: API.SH: Stock Analysis
info.description: The Stock Analysis API from API.SH: public Stock Analysis data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
US corporate actions: stock splits (forward and reverse, with ratio), new listings, delistings, symbol and name changes, spinoffs, acquisitions and bankruptcies, each with date, symbol, company and details. Recent lists come complete; for a past year the logged-out page lists the first 50 (`available` of `total`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockanalysis-actions

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Kind of action (default `all`).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: A past year, e.g. `2024`; leave it out for the recent list.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (default 100, max 2000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

get.description:
A stock's or ETF's dividends: annual dividend, yield, payout frequency and ratio, dividend growth, years of growth, buyback yield, next ex-dividend date, and the dividend history (ex-date, amount, record date, pay date) as the logged-out page lists it, plus the yearly dividend chart.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockanalysis-dividends

parameters.name: symbol

get.description:
A company's income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement or financial ratios by period: for each period the date, fiscal year and quarter and every line item the site shows (revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS, shares, cash, debt, assets, liabilities, operating and free cash flow, margins, PE, EV/EBITDA, ROE and more), with `rows` giving each line item's id, title and section. Logged-out pages show the latest 5 annual or 20 quarterly periods; `available_periods` is how many the site holds.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockanalysis-financials

get.summary: Stock Analysis stock and ETF screener
get.description:
Screen US-listed stocks or ETFs with the site's filters and sort and choose the fields returned: symbol, name and the default fields (stocks: market cap, price, change, industry, volume, PE; ETFs: asset class, assets, price, change, volume, expense ratio) plus any of 300+ fields (`columns`). Filters are `field-op-value` joined by commas, with ops `over`, `under`, `between` (`peRatio-between-5-15`), `is`, `isnot` (`sector-is-Technology`, `country-is-Germany`, `exchange-is-NASDAQ`), `includes` (`inIndex-includes-SP500`) and `notzero`. Returns the total matches. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockanalysis-screener

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: `stocks` (default) or `etf`.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Comma-separated filters, e.g. `sector-is-Technology,marketCap-over-10000000000,dividendYield-over-2`. Field ids from /stockanalysis/v1/screener-fields.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field id to sort by (any id from /stockanalysis/v1/screener-fields, e.g. `marketCap`, `peRatio`, `dividendYield`, `change`). Default: the list's own order.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order: `desc` (default) or `asc`.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Extra fields to include in each row, comma separated field ids from /stockanalysis/v1/screener-fields (e.g. `peRatio,dividendYield,revenueGrowth,sector`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (default 50, max 1000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockanalysis-statistics

parameters.name: symbol

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Optional exchange code for an international listing (e.g. `lon`, `tsx`, `fra`, `tyo`); the same as writing `LON:VOD` in symbol.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
